label: Statistics
summary: NLM describes Statistics as Topic in terms of collecting, summarizing and analyzing data subject to random variation, and explicitly distinguishes this subject from the Statistics publication type.

sources.title: OECD Frascati Manual 2015 — Fields of R&D classification

label: Neuroscience
summary: NLM describes the neurosciences as scientific disciplines concerned with the nervous system, including its embryology, anatomy, physiology, biochemistry and pharmacology, and places them among biological science disciplines.

sources.title: OECD Frascati Manual 2015 — Fields of R&D classification

label: Optics
summary: NLM's joint Optics and Photonics heading describes a field of physics and engineering studying light and technologies for analyzing, generating, transmitting and manipulating visible, infrared and ultraviolet electromagnetic radiation.

sources.title: OECD Frascati Manual 2015 — Fields of R&D classification

label: Taxonomy
summary: The Linnean Society describes biological taxonomy as the science of identifying, naming and classifying organisms.
